_instructions.step2: Create a new project or select existing project
_instructions.step3: Enable Google+ API and Google OAuth2 API
_instructions.step4: Go to 'Credentials' in the left sidebar
_instructions.step6: Choose 'Desktop application' as the application type
_instructions.step7: Add redirect URIs: http://localhost:8080 and http://localhost
_instructions.step8: Download the JSON file and replace the values above
_instructions.note: Make sure to keep your credentials secure and never commit them to version control
